core_obligations: Setup (proof lines 7251-7266): the total site is built from the simplicial object U of (Spaces/S)_fppf; the right-hand topoi may be represented by the spaces-etale sites; both total and component sites fall into case A of the simplicial-site situation (construction of U_etale; the fibre-product lemma for the total site).

The morphism of simplicial sites (lines 7268-7284): the component functors U |-> U/U_n and U |-> U/X are morphisms of sites (the a_{U_n} and a_X of the cited More-on-Cohomology section); they are compatible with the augmentations as in the remark, and the augmentation-morphism lemma for simplicial sites yields the commutative diagram of topoi of the statement.
proof_roadmap: Place both simplicial sites in case A of the simplicial-site situation.
Identify the component morphisms of sites with the a_{U_n}, a_X of the fppf-etale comparison.
Apply the morphism-of-augmented-simplicial-sites lemma to conclude the diagram.

H2: infrastructure lemma assembling established morphisms.
